def parse_pair(t,n):
    m=re.search(rf'Demo pair {n} input \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair {n} output \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)(?:\n\nSame instance\.|\Z)',t,re.S)
    if not m: raise ValueError(n)
    inp=[[int(x) for x in row.split()] for row in m.group(1).strip().splitlines()]
    out=[[int(x) for x in row.split()] for row in m.group(2).strip().splitlines()]
    return inp,out
pairs=[parse_pair(texts[i],i) for i in range(1,5)]
